* * * * * /bin/bash -lc 'export EXECJS_RUNTIME=Disabled && date > ~/cron-test.txt >> log/cron.log 2>> log/cron_errors.log'

0 5 * * * /bin/bash -lc 'export EXECJS_RUNTIME=Disabled && cd /workspace && RAILS_ENV=production bundle exec rake -s sitemap:refresh --silent >> log/cron.log 2>> log/cron_errors.log'

observation.command: cd /workspace && DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y -qq cron 2>&1 | tail -1; service cron start 2>&1; export PATH=/usr/local/ruby/bin:/opt/node/bin:$PATH PGPASSWORD=root RAILS_ENV=production && timeout 300 bundle exec whenever --update-crontab 2>&1 | tail -3; echo "EXIT=$?"; crontab -l 2>/dev/null | head -8
